prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en bön". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "prayer".
Scene: An adult seated in a quiet place with hands clasped and eyes softly closed in prayer, a small candle nearby, respectful peaceful mood, no beans.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "bön = prayer in this sentence.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon säger en stilla bön.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
